scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme - Sikkim
other_conditions: Applicant should not have any source of income.
Applicant should not be a recipient of salary/pension/family pension from the Central Government or other State Governments.
Applicant should have opened a bank account under Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana.
benefits_summary: Eligible beneficiaries receive a monthly pension of ₹2000.
